announcements.title: Exploring chat forking
announcements.summary: A quick glance and ramble about chat forking, a new feature coming to Ness soon (it's in experimental settings already)

announcements.title: Harness is now Ness
announcements.summary: We've decided to rename harness to ness. In theory you shouldn't have to do anything — the rename is backwards compatible.

announcements.title: Run your agents on any machine
announcements.summary: Connect the Ness desktop app to a headless server on another machine. One-click SSH setup, switch backends with a keystroke, notifications from every machine.

announcements.title: Introducing Chat mode
announcements.summary: A modern chat interface for Claude Code, built into Ness. Same agent, same auth, same MCP setup.
